verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no Veriff documentation on GDPR lawful bases, BIPA or other US biometric statutes, or recommended consent language. The only biometric mention is the Biometric Liveness feature description, which is about fraud detection, not lawful data handling. This axis clearly applies to an identity-verification vendor that processes biometric data, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor documents how biometric data is handled lawfully — GDPR bases, US biometric statutes like BIPA, and the consent language my flow needs — so legal review has something to review
